intelligence.essence: The board as built "is not alive at all, no activeness" — and he gave the structure that makes it alive. One major board, with inner boards inside it that display the text and light up too — usually two inner boards, sometimes three on the odd slide, like a mini intelligent board. Most slides should use 2–3 boards, not one big board, because broken-up and elevated is easier to read. If a slide has no image and no video, the whole thing becomes one slide that lights up and is readable. And the board itself is not built new: go grab the intelligent board from the Hub — the exact code, already raised and elevated, looking as it should — use PART of it, not the whole thing. It sits beside the player for now; when the player is not there, the whole frame becomes the intelligent board. The player's video and image area IS an intelligent block, with an image in it.
